blocks.title: 100% TMX Server
blocks.tagline: Random map servers of the 100% TMX project for TrackMania Nations, United and ESWC.

items.title: Random maps
items.text: Players get random maps that nobody has finished on TMX yet.

items.title: Replays for TMX
items.text: After each finish a replay link that TMX accepts, because TMX only takes server-saved replays.

items.title: Reports and presets
items.text: Impossible and hard map reports, genre presets and votes for maps and presets.

items.title: Runs 24/7
items.text: Offline map pool, watchdogs, and several servers on one machine.

blocks.title: Where it comes from
blocks.markdown:
A fork of Randomizer Anywhere by BigBang1112, which starts a dedicated server and runs a Random Map Challenge controlled by chat commands. This fork runs the three public servers of the 100% TMX project.

It is a .NET console app. No builds are distributed; the live servers run from source builds. For ESWC, a chat hint points players to the ESWC Autosave mod instead of a replay link.
